method: Independent re-derivation. Project sources read with cat/grep/diff only (no lake/lean). Upstream fetched with curl through the session proxy (TLS verified) from raw.githubusercontent.com at each cited pin and at main. Raw `diff` plus a wrapper-normalized `diff` (drop everything before `variable {n`, map `@[simp, category API, AMS 35]`->`@[simp]`, delete `@[category API, AMS 35]` and `@[category research open, AMS 35]` lines, `local notation`->`notation`, `end NavierStokes.Comparator`->`end NavierStokes`). Residual of the normalized diff is listed under navier_stokes_diff; every other line is character-identical.

wrapper_differences: Header: project adds 'This file has been modified from its original form in the Formal Conjectures project.' (lines 4-5).

Import: upstream `import FormalConjecturesUtil` (which at the pin is `public import Mathlib` + `FormalConjecturesForMathlib` + linter/attribute modules) -> project `import Mathlib`. Upstream is compiled under Lean's `module` system (`module`/`public import`), the project is not.
Module docstring: project adds provenance paragraph; drops the Clay PDF reference line, the (A)/(B) bullet list, and the errata paragraph (upstream 49-53). Docstring only.

`open ContDiff Set InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory EuclideanGeometry` -> `open ContDiff Set InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory` (EuclideanGeometry was opened upstream to activate the scoped ℝ^ / ℝ³ notations; the project inlines them as local notation instead). Dropping `open EuclideanGeometry` also removes EuclideanGeometry.* names from unqualified lookup; none of the declarations in the file use any EuclideanGeometry.* name (they use fderiv, iteratedFDeriv(Within), gradient, Δ (scoped Laplacian, opened in both), MemLp, EuclideanSpace.single, ContDiff(On), derivWithin — all non-EuclideanGeometry).

`namespace NavierStokes` -> `namespace NavierStokes.Comparator`; `end NavierStokes` -> `end NavierStokes.Comparator`. Every declaration is therefore renamed NavierStokes.X -> NavierStokes.Comparator.X (uniform prefix; not listed per-declaration above).
Notation scoping: `notation "∇⬝"` -> `local notation "∇⬝"`; scoped ℝ^/ℝ³ -> local (same expansions and precedence).

Attributes: `category API`, `category research open`, `AMS 35` removed everywhere (Formal-Conjectures metadata/linter attributes, not Mathlib); `@[simp]` kept where present; `@[inherit_doc]` on ∇⬝ kept.

Upstream transitive import FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Geometry/3d.lean also provides `instance Module.orientedEuclideanSpaceFinThree : Module.Oriented ℝ ℝ³ (Fin 3)` and `instance fact_finrank_euclideanSpace_fin_three : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ ℝ³ = 3)`; the project does not inline these. No declaration in the NS file mentions orientation, cross product, or finrank, so I found no use site; see could_not_determine for the elaboration caveat.
Toolchain/Mathlib: upstream pin 8bf45ed7 = lean4 v4.27.0 + mathlib a3a10db0; project = lean4 v4.34.0-rc2 + mathlib 85e3a25e. Same source text elaborated against different Mathlib revisions.
